selection.ranking: descending absolute pooled Hedges g on observed training values
selection.eligibility: at least two finite observations per class and positive pooled within-class variance

preprocessing: training-only median imputation and StandardScaler; no hyperparameter tuning
primary_metric: mean of domain-specific AUCs; CV averages AUCs over five repetitions, not probabilities
confidence_intervals: pointwise percentile 95%, paired source-group bootstrap within each domain; LGO within each source generator; same group draw for all configurations and repetitions; fixed predictions, no refitting
random_configurations: mean AUC over 100 fixed unique uniform quaternes and 100 fixed unique matched quaternes (three POS and one lexical); subset distributions also shown; no best-subset selection
holdouts: leave-one-domain-out: train two domains, test third, remove connected test groups
leave-one-generator-out: train six generators, test seventh and its associated humans, remove all test groups
prior_data_inspection: historical feature effects, shortlist and AUCs already inspected; settings frozen before these additional fits, not preregistration of the historical exploration
selection_differs_from_historical_rule: C3 uses pooled |g|, not the historical all-domain and generator-consistency filters
data_description: 900 length-matched design associations (one human and one machine each), 300 per domain; same-row semantic correspondence is not guaranteed; 900 groups in frozen input
limitations: topic and corpus artifacts may contribute, especially numerals and proper nouns
repeated folds and source group bootstrap do not provide independent dataset confirmation
random references and confidence intervals conditional on chosen draws/fixed held-out predictions
no inference about humanization quality or naturalness from classifier AUC
cv_group_randomization: For each CV seed randomly relabel entire group IDs before StratifiedGroupKFold; this ensures distinct repetitions when every group has identical class composition.
implementation_correction: An initial attempt produced identical five-fold partitions for all seeds under sklearn 1.7.2. It was excluded before AUC analysis. No feature, model, random panel or metric choice was changed. Only group randomization was corrected before the final fits.
